{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Full Bloom}}''' – Upon death, spawns one [[Hefty]], two [[Odd]]s and two [[Swift]]s. }} ==Description== The '''Mandrake''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health and slightly fast speed. On death, it will summon one [[Hefty]], two [[Odd]]s and two [[Swift]]s. ==Logbook Description== "''The Mandrake enjoys being a bush. After the flowers have consumed an Odd, if they are too weak they will oftentimes not have enough strength to turn into a Mandragora. So, these little guys do the next best thing. They have formed a clique of their own and will often run in groups to nowhere in particular. Hundreds of them would gather and march. The ones who hate them the most are the Void Pikes, who have to deal with the constant traffic blockage.''" ==Appearance== The '''Mandrake''' is a bush primarily containing mandrake flowers. On top of the bush, there are multiple purple crystals. Under the bush, two legs can be seen. ==Strategy== *The '''Mandrake''' can easily be taken care of by cheap towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Saboteur]] or [[Crook Boss]], though sufficient DPS should be considered when they spawn in later on with [[Aggro]], [[Bloated]] or [[Nimble]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Mandrake''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MandrakeIconIG.png|'''Mandrake''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mandrake''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Mandrake''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **[[Stun Immunity]] added. {{Hardcore|[[Hefty]]|Wave 4|Mandrake|Wave 8|[[Phantom]]|Wave 10}} {{Voidcore|[[Blighted]]|Wave 18|Mandrake|Wave 19|[[Voidling]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]] [[Category:Mid-Game]]
